findings.statement: In the ProductLaunchNew sample, 42 items about NVIDIA were labelled by stance: 20 positive, 20 neutral, 1 negative, and 1 mixed; this is a sample snapshot, not representative customer sentiment.
In the ProductLaunchNew sample, 10 items about Broadcom were labelled by stance: 4 positive, 2 neutral, 2 negative, and 2 mixed; this is a sample snapshot, not representative customer sentiment.
In the ProductLaunchNew sample, one item about Intel was labelled neutral; the sample is too small to characterize customer sentiment toward Intel.

The ProductLaunchNew customer-trends run collected 204 evidence items: 112 web, 40 social comments, 32 social posts, and 20 news items; platform attribution was unknown for 132 items and YouTube for 72.
The ProductLaunchNew sample included a DGX Station overview theme with three items, two labelled neutral and one positive; this small theme count does not establish broader buyer preference.
The ProductLaunchNew run collected no search-interest series, so it did not establish demand trends over time.

metadata.source_note: These expectations intentionally mirror computed counts and coverage in one Edrak run so the comparator can measure output similarity. They are not independent customer ground truth; do not use the resulting similarity score as evidence that the customer claims are correct.
